caption: The drawing displays a detailed pencil sketch of a pitcher or jug with a large, rounded body that narrows at its base and mouth, a pronounced outward flaring spout on the left, and an ornate handle on the right that curls upward before looping downward. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background, with shading emphasizing the form’s volume. There are three smaller, detailed diagrams in separate boxes around the main object: one at the lower left showing the full silhouette of the pitcher with measurements, one at the bottom center showing a top-down cross-sectional view in the shape of a rounded heart, and one at the lower right that depicts the shape, profile, and attachment of the handle with respective measurements. A labeled scale is present below the main drawing, along with the handwritten word "MEYERS." The pitcher itself appears symmetrical, and fine lines define its horizontal bands and contours, while soft shadowing suggests a three-dimensional shape. No colors other than the grayscale tones from graphite pencil are present.
title: Pewter Pitcher
